resources.string: Soil-referenced (recommended): measures the soil colour in the image and subtracts the colour cast of the light – validated in low sun and overcast light (field trial 10/2026). Dense stands (cover above ~50 %) are underestimated – check them by eye

Untreated area (not harrowed), photographed right before AND after harrowing under the same light. The app uses it to remove light and time-of-day effects from the CSC. Without control images the analysis runs as before.
Control area: please select before AND after images – or leave both empty.
Control area: cover changed by %1$s (relative) although it was not harrowed – mainly the light/time-of-day effect (also dew, wind, framing). This change has been removed from the CSC.
Control area analysed, but no correction possible (no vegetation detected on the control area) – the CSC above is without control reference.
Control area analysed, but no correction possible: the raw CSC cannot be computed (no cover on the treated before images).
Control area analysed, but no correction possible: the control images have no value for the CSC basis – the CSC above is without control reference.
No rows were detected on the control area – its change was measured on the total plant cover.
